meta.description: Validates docked or generated protein-ligand poses with PoseBusters physical-validity tests, relative MMFF strain, supplementary planarity diagnostics, and batch QC before downstream SAR analysis.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All tested numeric and configuration claims came from live PoseBusters 0.6.5/RDKit 2026.03.6 execution; no clinical or efficacy claims were generated.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill performs computational pose QC and consistently frames results as checks for inspection, not diagnostic or therapeutic conclusions.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill distinguishes a supplementary SVD planarity diagnostic from PoseBusters' authoritative check, treats strain as a relative diagnostic rather than a free energy, and avoids a universal strain cutoff.

code_usability.detail: All three shipped Python entry points and the inline redock pattern executed from an audit-owned exact-tip snapshot; 30/30 audited assertions passed.

functional_suitability.note: Covers dock, redock, ligand-only, strain, planarity, and per-file batch QC with correct reference-dependent configuration guidance.

reliability.note: Run paths return structured notes for unscorable strain input and use deterministic boolean aggregation; CLI argument validation and a clearer batch-selection diagnostic would improve recovery.

performance_context.note: The normal workflow relies on focused RDKit/PoseBusters calculations and exposes a conformer-count control for the only expensive path.

agent_usability.note: Trigger, config table, commands, error table, and direct script destinations are precise; the overloaded batch output label is a minor agent-reading ambiguity.

human_usability.note: Workflow-oriented sections, concise usage guide, and warnings against absolute rejection make the Skill directly navigable.

security.note: No credential, network, destructive-operation, or raw-command-execution pattern was found; arbitrary supplied file paths are normal local scientific inputs.

maintainability.note: Runnable logic is now in named scripts with purpose/input/usage headers and an asserted fixture smoke test; there is no dedicated automated test suite for CLI argument errors.

agent_specific.note: Frontmatter trigger is specific, version compatibility is explicit, and optional posecheck has a working PoseBusters path; batch rank naming remains the only small escape-hatch clarity gap.

key_strengths: All seven Phase-1 input classes were rerun against the exact assigned commit and two fresh boundary cases passed.
The source now has direct script destinations for the former inline runnable blocks, and each shipped entry point ran from an exact-tip audit snapshot.
Live execution confirms correct handling of reference-dependent stereochemistry, planarity diagnostic limits, physical failures, and malformed strain input.

recommendations.title: Clarify batch rank output semantics
recommendations.problem: pose_qc_batch.py prints a column named rank, but it is a cumulative count of PB-valid records within each source, not a docking score or original pose ordinal.
recommendations.root_cause: The internal selection implementation exposes an intermediate column without describing its semantics in the CLI output.
recommendations.fix: Rename the displayed column to valid_ordinal or omit it from the CLI table; keep the documented first-PB-valid selection behavior unchanged.
